label: Title
description:
Primary Title - Main title used to identify and display the asset, e.g., Portrait of a Young Woman
Alternate Title - Alternative or variant title, e.g., Young Woman Portrait
Determination - Used for taxon records where title does not apply
displaySpec:
1 - Title displays as it is in source system(CMS)
2 - This is mandatory data; CCS cannot display a record without a title

label: Object Type
description: Broad type of collection asset represented by the record
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
questions: What is the data type for Object type?

label: Date
encompasses: Display values- Earliest, latest dates - Date collected - Created Period
description:
Date or date range when the asset was produced
Created period -> Named historical or cultural period
displaySpec:
1 - If 'display value' is available, CCS will display as-is
2 - If 'date collected' is available, CCS will display as-is
examples:
c. 1920 
Middle Ages or Ming Dynasty

label: Creator
encompasses: Person Name, DoB, DoD, Role - Cultural affiliation - Organisation Name
description: Person or organisation responsible for creating the asset, e.g., John Longstaff
displaySpec:
1 - Creator can be person or organisation (which is association)
2 - Values displayed in CCS will be as per the source system - display value
3 - For person, the values displayed would be in this order - "Full name (Dob - DoD) [nationality] role"
4 - For organisation, the values displayed would be in this order - "organisation name (estab. DoB, closed. DoD)"
5 - If any of the values are not available, then CCS will just not display the data
examples:
For person, Rupert Bunny (29 September 1864 - 25 May 1947) [Australian] Artist
For organisation - Harringtons Metallurigists Pty Ltd (estab. 1906, closed 2002)
For organisation - Harringtons Metallurigists Pty Ltd (estab. 1906)
For organisation - Harringtons Metallurigists Pty Ltd (closed 2002)

label: Associated Entity
description: Other people, organisations or groups associated with the asset.
displaySpec:
1 - Display order will be <Org name (DoB - DoD), role>
2 - When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear
questions: What is the data type for Association?

label: Place
encompasses: L1, L2, L3, L4, L5 of Place - Collection Site
description: Place where the asset was produced, e.g., Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
displaySpec: When any data is not available, it will be blank and label also does not appear

label: Dimensions
encompasses: Measures - Height, width, depth, diameter, weights, units, display value
description: Physical or technical measurements
displaySpec:
1 - The information displayed on CCS will depend on the data available in source system
2 - CCS label will be 'Dimensions (H x W x D)'
3 - The value displayed will be whats available from source system.
4 - Any available data needs to be displayed with the units (Units of measure)
5 - The value displayed will have the details of the object along with the dimensions 
6 - The information will be displayed as per the 'display value' when available (Example is MDHS)
examples:
Vase 180 x 30 x 100 cm
Vase 180 cm
Vase 180 x 30 cm
Vase 180 x 100 cm
